title: Resolving Auto-Update Issues for Zscaler Client Connector Linux 1.2

blocks.text: Prior to upgrading to version 1.2 for Linux, Zscaler Client Connector for Linux 1.1 needs an adjustment in order to address an issue with auto-updates for Ubuntu users. Until these changes are made, an auto-update to Linux 1.2 will not work.
